findings: The book says tetrahedral shapes are common for d7, d8 and d10 ions and then gives [MnCl4]2- (Mn2+ is d5, as Quick Check 18.3 says); the d-electron list is not carried. The Quick Check questions are printed without answers; the lesson's answers were derived for it and need the second-person review.
